why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the xDFi alpha site Go to the official xDFi alpha homepage at alpha.xdfi.net . The airdrop invitation sits at the top of the page, under the main headline.
2 Step 2 : Join the waitlist Select the Join Waitlist button and follow the sign-up. xDFi says this makes you a recipient of the $100K airdrop.

3 Step 3 : Follow xDFi for next steps The project has not published a snapshot, a claim date or a payout amount. Check its official homepage again for any update on how the $100K airdrop will be distributed.
